con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), ":memory:") 

dbWriteTable( 
    con, 
    "superstore", 
    superstore, 
    overwrite = TRUE 
)
ventas_mensuales <- dbGetQuery( 
    con, 
    " 
    SELECT 
      strftime(
      '%Y-%m-01',
      date('1970-01-01', order_date || ' days')
      ) AS period,
      SUM(Sales) AS sales, 
      AVG(Sales) AS average_sale, 
      COUNT(*) AS transactions 
    FROM superstore 
    WHERE order_date IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY period 
    ORDER BY period 
    " 
)

    modelo, 
    newdata = test 
)

pred_resumen <- tibble( 
    period = test$period, 
    observed = test$sales, 
    predicted_median = apply(predicciones, 2, median), 
    lower_90 = apply(predicciones, 2, quantile, probs = 0.05), 
    upper_90 = apply(predicciones, 2, quantile, probs = 0.95) 
)
pred_resumen

  period     observed predicted_median lower_90 upper_90
  <date>        <dbl>            <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>

5 2017-11-01  118448.           89041.   72043.  106620.
6 2017-12-01   83829.           91713.   75287.  109644.
ggplot(pred_resumen, aes(x = period)) + 
  geom_ribbon( 
      aes(ymin = lower_90, 
          ymax = upper_90), 
      alpha = 0.20 ) + 
  geom_line( 
      aes(y = observed), 
      linewidth = 1 
  ) + 
  geom_point( 
      aes(y = observed), 
      size = 2 
  ) + 
  geom_line( 
      aes(y = predicted_median), 
      linetype = "dashed", 
      linewidth = 0.9 
  ) + 
  geom_point( 
      aes(y = predicted_median), 
      size = 2 
  ) + 
  labs( 
      title = "Predicciones frente a las ventas observadas", 
      subtitle = "La banda representa el intervalo predictivo del 90%", 
      x = NULL, 
      y = "Ventas" 
  ) + 
  theme_minimal()
metricas <- pred_resumen %>% 
  summarise(
      MAE = mean(abs(observed - predicted_median)), 
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((observed - predicted_median)^2)), 
      cobertura_90 = mean( 
          observed >= lower_90 & 
          observed <= upper_90 
      ) 
  )
metricas

errores <- pred_resumen %>% 
  mutate( 
      error = observed - predicted_median 
  )
